title: Enable root npm SBOM metadata
summary: Declare the private root npm tool project's release-aligned version so npm can emit a standards-based CycloneDX dependency SBOM.
reason: npm sbom failed with EINVALIDPURLTYPE because the root package had no version and therefore could not produce a valid package URL.
behavior_before: The locked root dependency graph audited cleanly, but npm could not serialize it as CycloneDX because the private root package lacked version metadata.
behavior_after: package.json and package-lock.json identify the private root package as 2026.6.4-001, and the integrated npm graph emits a CycloneDX SBOM containing 88 dependency components.
manual_validation: PASS: npm install --package-lock-only completed with zero vulnerabilities.
PASS: npm sbom --sbom-format cyclonedx emitted valid CycloneDX 1.5 JSON with 88 components after the integrated ESLint 10 graph update.
PASS: npm audit --audit-level=moderate reported zero vulnerabilities.
rollback_plan: Remove the root version fields through npm tooling and rerun npm ci/audit; doing so intentionally restores the documented npm SBOM limitation.
notes: The project remains private and non-published. This adds identity metadata only; it does not claim or alter a software license. SBOM evidence was generated outside the repository and is not a shipped artifact.
